_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Score barely moves, BTC flat 30d, funding neutral, and no breaker (ETF/stablecoin/Fed liquidity) is turning—coil base rate favors HOLD over a forced directional call.
next_move.brains_agree: Yes on phase Anxiety and non-directional stance; narrative is weaker/passive while analyst explicitly calls HOLD/CAUTION coil
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC stays inside ~1.5% range with funding near 0.01% and no impulse in ETF flows or Fed liquidity
next_move.invalidated_if: Real range break: downside if price slides with funding negative and ETF flows dead, or upside if spot demand persists and ETF/stablecoin flows actually turn up
